questions.q: What good news did Polly bring Jerry at the start of the chapter?
choices: Mrs. Briggs wanted him to drive her again
Jerry had won a prize from the cab company
Harry had found a job at a grocer's shop
A new horse was coming from the country
questions.evidence: Mrs. Briggs sent her servant this afternoon to ask you to take her out to-morrow at eleven o'clock

questions.q: Why did Mrs. Briggs want Jerry's cab back?
choices: Other cabs were not as clean or as well driven
Jerry had promised to drive her on Sundays
Jerry had lowered his price for every trip she took
Her own carriage horse had died that winter
questions.evidence: there is not one of them so nice and clean as yours

questions.q: Why did Dinah Brown need to travel on a Sunday?
choices: Her mother was dangerously ill
She was going to her sister's wedding
She had to start a new job in the country
Her house had burned down in the night

questions.q: Why could Dinah not simply take the train?
choices: She would still have four miles to walk, and she was weak
There were no trains running at all on Sunday
She had lost her ticket and had no more money
The train did not go anywhere near the country
questions.evidence: she should still have four miles to walk

questions.q: What was Jerry's real worry about taking Dinah?
choices: Losing his Sunday when he and the horses were tired
Not getting paid because Dinah was poor
Getting lost on the twisting country lanes after dark
Breaking the law with only a six-days' license
questions.evidence: It was not the money I was thinking about, but of losing our Sunday

questions.q: What "golden rule" did Polly remind Jerry of?
choices: Do to others as you would have them do to you
Never work on a Sunday for any reason at all
Always get paid before you drive anyone anywhere
Early to bed and early to rise makes a man wise
questions.evidence: we should do to other people as we should like they should do to us

questions.q: What did Jerry ask Polly to do before he left?
choices: Ask butcher Braydon to lend his light trap
Buy a new set of harness for Jack
Send a letter to Dinah's mother to say they were coming
Fetch the doctor for Dinah's baby
questions.evidence: ask him if he would lend me his light trap

questions.q: What did Jack do in the meadow at Dinah's family farm?
choices: He ate grass, rolled, rested, and galloped by turns
He stayed tied in the cowshed all afternoon
He helped Dinah's brother pull a plow across the field
He slept in the shade the whole time

questions.q: How did Jerry feel about the day when he got home?
choices: Happy; he felt he had not lost his Sunday after all
Angry that he had worked so hard on his day off
Sad because Dinah's mother had died before they came
Worried about how little money he had earned
questions.evidence: I have not lost my Sunday after all
